description: Defines the Half type (half-precision floating-point) including conversions to standard C types and basic arithmetic operations, with platform-specific implementations and limits.

classes.name: c10::Half
classes.description: Represents a half-precision floating-point type with platform-specific conversions and arithmetic operators.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the Half value as a float to an ostream.

methods.name: fp16_ieee_to_fp32_value
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit IEEE half-precision float in bit form to a 32-bit float.

methods.name: fp16_ieee_from_fp32_value
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit float to a 16-bit IEEE half-precision float in bit form.

methods.name: fp16_ieee_to_fp32_bits
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit half to 32-bit float bits without using floating-point operations.

methods.name: fp16_ieee_from_fp32_bits
methods.description: Converts 32-bit float bits to 16-bit half bits without using floating-point operations.
